metadata.source_section: Module B-2.2 outline of individual activities/actions/measures
notes: This file uses the 58-record Krakow manual-scan baseline, not the later broader 98-record automated Krakow subset.
Each initiative keeps source line pointers and source-grounded extracted fields only.

initiatives.initiative_name: Programme of thermal modernisation of single-family buildings for the City of Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Resident subsidies for single-family thermal modernisation, including insulation of walls, roofs and floors plus replacement of windows and doors, with at least 25% heating-demand reduction required.
initiatives.objective_text: Thermo-modernisation of buildings to improve energy efficiency and support investment in thermal modernisation and RES programmes.
initiatives.implementation_text: City of Krakow Department of Air Quality; local action for residents, construction companies, contractors and energy auditors.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 1,255 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Costs 2018-2024 approx. PLN 17,000,000; estimated 2025-2030 approx. PLN 25,000,000; total approx. PLN 42,000,000.

planned.subsidy_cap: 50% of eligible costs and no more than PLN 25,000

initiatives.initiative_name: Thermomodernisation of educational buildings of the Municipality of Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Energy modernisation of selected educational buildings based on audits, including envelope insulation, window and door replacement, and central heating system replacement or modernisation.
initiatives.objective_text: Thermo-modernisation of buildings to improve energy efficiency.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Education Service Centre; school administrators and construction companies.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 554 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; later years will continue related educational-building measures.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 4,430,505, approx. EUR 984,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: 2021-2023, with later continuation measures.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Thermomodernisation of municipal buildings, public buildings and the Municipal Social Welfare Centre in Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Thermo-modernisation of municipal, public, residential, residential-utility and historic buildings through the Integrated Territorial Investment facility for the Krakow Metropolis.
initiatives.objective_text: Improve energy efficiency of public buildings, reduce air and CO2 pollution, and improve public-facility comfort.
initiatives.implementation_text: Krakow Metropolis Association with the Municipality of Krakow; covers municipal and public stock and involves residents, poor and homeless people, and property managers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 1,038 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Design phase; no timetable or milestones currently available.
initiatives.funding_text: Co-financed by European Fund for Malopolska 2021-2027; estimated investment costs approx. PLN 45,000,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Design phase; no current timetable.

initiatives.initiative_name: Renewable energy system for residential heating and energy generation and Modernisation of buildings and premises owned by ZBK.
initiatives.general_description: Renewable energy solutions for efficient residential heating and energy generation plus modernisation of ZBK buildings and premises to improve efficiency, aesthetics and quality.
initiatives.objective_text: Thermo-modernisation of buildings and development of RES-based solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Buildings Administration (ZBK); local action involving housing associations and residents.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: No receipts, costs, energy output or GHG reduction values are present in the extracted source segment.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: No funding or cost detail is present in the extracted source segment.

initiatives.initiative_name: Use of waste heat at the Plaszow Sewage Treatment Plant.
initiatives.general_description: Use of waste heat from sludge combustion at the Sludge Thermal Treatment Station to heat process facilities.
initiatives.objective_text: Action to decarbonise the district heating system.
initiatives.implementation_text: Waterworks of the City of Krakow S.A.; local energy system action involving enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Thermal power 300 kW; estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 932 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: No funding or cost detail is present in the extracted source segment.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date 2024.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of heat pump fed by municipal wastewater.
initiatives.general_description: Bottom-source heat pump fed by municipal wastewater to improve the city district heating system.
initiatives.objective_text: Decarbonise district heating, support change in energy generation structure, and use waste-source energy.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Heating Company S.A. (MPEC); supplies the Krakow energy system and involves businesses and residents.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Capacity approx. 30 MW; estimated reductions: 88,540 tCO2e in Buildings and heating and 4,660 tCO2e in Waste Management and CE.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; broader description to be added as project develops.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 258,000,000, approx. EUR 57,333,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Implementation of a local energy programme based on heat pumps with a capacity of approximately 1 MW.
initiatives.general_description: Local energy programme using heat pumps to improve the city district heating system.
initiatives.objective_text: Decarbonise district heating and support change in energy generation structure.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Heating Company (MPEC); supplies the Krakow energy system and involves businesses and residents.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Power approx. 1 MW; estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 3,107 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; broader description to be added as project develops.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment outlay PLN 7,000,000, approx. EUR 1,555,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Project NEEST - NetZero Emission and Environmentally Sustainable Territories.
initiatives.general_description: Innovation project producing practical, replicable schemes for building energy-efficiency improvement through thermo-modernisation, organisational change, financing guidance and urban-quarter upgrade models.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop financing models, district and community energy models, building thermo-modernisation system solutions, and recommendations for energy-company investment.
initiatives.implementation_text: Project partners; Krakow side Department of Municipal Economy and Climate. National dissemination with partner cities, residents, authorities, businesses and NCBR.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated reductions: 192 tCO2e in Buildings and heating and 48 tCO2e in Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: EU Horizon 2020; total funds PLN 6,500,000, including PLN 1,295,181 for Krakow.

initiatives.initiative_name: Large-scale programme of deep thermo-modernisation of buildings in Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Large-scale building thermal modernisation using subsidy expansion, government programmes, ESCO financing, One Stop Shop retrofit services and historic-building retrofit solutions.
initiatives.objective_text: Thermo-modernise buildings, support thermal modernisation and RES programmes, develop financing schemes and community energy solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; city-wide action involving companies, energy companies, building managers, housing associations, residents, investors, developers, banks and funds.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Energy removed/replaced in 2030: 843,057 MWh/year from single and multi-family buildings and 476,079 MWh/year from historic buildings; reduction 456,168 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 13,300,000,000; includes National Reconstruction Plan, Warm Housing, Stop Smog, ESCO and OSS financing/service models.

initiatives.initiative_name: Decarbonisation of the district heating system with the development of a district heating network.
initiatives.general_description: Development of waste heat and RES sources for district heating, construction of Energy Recovery Plant line 3 for thermal waste conversion with cogeneration, and district heating network modernisation and expansion.
initiatives.objective_text: Decarbonise district heating, produce energy from waste sources, invest in storage technologies, and change generation structure.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; city-wide action involving municipal companies, private companies and energy companies.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Processes approx. 100,000 Mg/year waste, reduces landfilled waste by 99,000 Mg/year, produces 60,000 MWh/year electricity and approx. 330,000 GJ/year heat; 2030 generation 183,300 MWh/year; reductions 30,708 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 13,100 tCO2e Waste Management/CE.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap and includes network expansion to peripheral districts.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 915,500,000, EUR 203,444,000.

planned.plant_capacity: 6.6 MWe/20.24 MWt plus 6.5 MWt flue gas heat recovery

initiatives.initiative_name: Campaign for zero-emission buildings construction and emissions reduction in the building sector.
initiatives.general_description: Campaign for advanced building refurbishment and zero-emission construction technologies, including smart systems, automation, prefabricated insulation, mechanical ventilation with heat recovery, NZEB baselines, energy communities and climate-neutral quarters.
initiatives.objective_text: Promote building technology modernisation, implement energy standards for new buildings, run energy-saving education campaigns and develop community energy models.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; city-wide action involving municipal and private companies, developers, residents, construction companies, scientific institutes and NGOs.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated reduction in Buildings and heating: 42,472 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap and includes updates to regulations and land-use plans.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 30,000,000, approx. EUR 6,666,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Programme for the development of RES in the Municipality of Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Municipal programme for PV installations on municipal buildings, facilities and properties, reactive power compensation, and utility consumption and PV production management systems.
initiatives.objective_text: Increase renewable energy production, reduce grid electricity demand, improve grid efficiency and reduce CO2 and other pollutants.
initiatives.implementation_text: Climate - Energy - Water Management (KEGW); municipal buildings; residents, businesses and property managers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Current 13 installations totaling 546.6 kW with average annual electricity production 533,827 MWh; assumed 2030 production 854 MWh; reductions 126 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 502 tCO2e Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs up to 2030 PLN 30,000,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: 2020-2030; scheduled completion in 2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Programme for the development of renewable energy sources in the Municipality of Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: Subsidies for residents and housing organisations for heat pumps, solar collectors, PV, electricity storage, energy management systems and EV charging stations.
initiatives.objective_text: Support thermal modernisation and RES investment, invest in energy storage technologies and develop RES-based solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow Department of Air Quality; residents, housing associations, housing communities and contractors.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Renewable energy depends on stakeholder applications and will be completed later; estimated reductions 483 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 1,931 tCO2e Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; housing organisation call has not occurred due to insufficient funding.

initiatives.initiative_name: Modernisation of the biogas tanks at the Plaszow Sewage Treatment Plant.
initiatives.general_description: Replacement of two biogas tanks with larger tanks able to operate from 100% to 20% full, enabling fuller use of biogas and increased green energy generation.
initiatives.objective_text: Action to decarbonise the district heating system.
initiatives.implementation_text: Waterworks of the City of Krakow; extracted source segment does not include scale, stakeholders, timetable or cost fields.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Replacement of 2 biogas tanks; no GHG reduction, energy output or cost values are present in the extracted source segment.
initiatives.delivery_text: No delivery details are present beyond responsible entity.
initiatives.funding_text: No funding or cost detail is present in the extracted source segment.
initiatives.timeline_text: No timeline detail is present in the extracted source segment.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of a photovoltaic installation at the Barycz landfill site.
initiatives.general_description: PV installation on reclaimed Barycz landfill land to power waste treatment facilities at the Barycz Environmental Centre, with surplus sent to the grid.
initiatives.objective_text: Support change in electricity generation at city plants and design new photovoltaic farms.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Cleaning Company; local energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Approx. 957 MWh/year renewable electricity; estimated Electricity reduction 657 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 6,000,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of photovoltaic farms by Krakow Municipal Holding.
initiatives.general_description: PV farm with energy storage to increase stabilisation and self-consumption of green energy; land for larger farm to be newly acquired.
initiatives.objective_text: Support change in electricity generation at city plants and design new photovoltaic farms.
initiatives.implementation_text: Krakow Municipal Holding; supplies city energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Two farms with approx. 2 MWp and 300 kWp installed capacity; estimated Electricity reduction 1,352 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; preliminary planning, no set completion date.
initiatives.funding_text: Cost included in KMH photovoltaic allocation approx. PLN 10-20 million.
initiatives.timeline_text: Preliminary planning phase; no set completion dates.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of a photovoltaic farm at the Raba Water Treatment Plant.
initiatives.general_description: PV farm under construction at the Raba Water Treatment Plant.
initiatives.objective_text: Support change in electricity generation at city plants and design new photovoltaic farms.
initiatives.implementation_text: Waterworks of the City of Krakow S.A.; supplies city energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: PV farm capacity 950 kW; estimated Electricity reduction 698 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 8,200,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date 2024.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of new CHP systems.
initiatives.general_description: Construction of H2Ready cogeneration systems to move the city energy system toward lower carbon intensity.
initiatives.objective_text: Decarbonise district heating, develop RES-based solutions, support change in generation structure and invest in energy storage technologies.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Heating Company S.A.; supplies Krakow energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Capacity approx. 13 MW; reductions 6,803 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 27,212 tCO2e Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; broader description to be added as project develops.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 92,000,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of photovoltaic farms and local installations by MPEC.
initiatives.general_description: Construction of PV farms and local PV installations by MPEC to make the city energy system less carbon-intensive.
initiatives.objective_text: Support change in electricity generation at city plants and design new photovoltaic farms.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipal Heating Company S.A.; supplies Krakow energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Capacity approx. 32 MW; estimated Electricity reduction 23,520 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap; broader description to be added as project develops.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 134,000,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Construction of energy storages.
initiatives.general_description: Scalable energy storage facility at the Thermal Waste Conversion Plant under the ZIT instrument for the Krakow Metropolitan Area.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop RES-based solutions, reduce air pollution and CO2, improve energy efficiency and increase renewable energy share.
initiatives.implementation_text: Krakow Metropolia Association, Municipality of Krakow and Krakow Municipal Holding S.A.; Thermal Waste Conversion Plant; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Electricity-sector reduction is hard to estimate and will be completed in a future update.
initiatives.delivery_text: Design phase with no timetable or milestones currently available.
initiatives.funding_text: Secured funding from European Fund for Malopolska 2021-2027; estimated investment costs PLN 2,000,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Design phase; no current timetable.

initiatives.initiative_name: Installation of two cogeneration units at the Plaszow Treatment Plant.
initiatives.general_description: Two cogeneration units, each 800 kW electrical and 790 kW thermal, plus transformer station, transformers and low-/medium-voltage switchgear.
initiatives.objective_text: Decarbonise district heating, develop RES-based solutions, support change in generation structure and invest in energy storage technologies.
initiatives.implementation_text: Waterworks of the City of Krakow S.A.; local energy system; enterprises.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Two CHP units; reductions 592 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 2,366 tCO2e Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap and is in final implementation.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 8,000,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date 2024.

initiatives.initiative_name: Modernisation of road lighting in Krakow.
initiatives.general_description: LED luminaires and lighting management system, including lamp replacement, telecom controllers, reactive power reduction, remote management software and cabinet adaptation.
initiatives.objective_text: Reduce electricity consumption through technological upgrades.
initiatives.implementation_text: Krakow City Roads Board; city-boundary action involving residents and businesses.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated Electricity reduction 4,408 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 85,712,361.

initiatives.initiative_name: ATELIER project - AmsTErdam and BiLbao citizen drivEn smaRt cities.
initiatives.general_description: Smart-cities and Positive Energy District project for knowledge sharing and replication; Krakow objectives include PED skills, Innovation Atelier, RES integration into district heating/cooling, replication planning, stakeholder involvement and City Vision 2050.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop district and community energy model solutions with citizen involvement and run energy-saving education campaigns.
initiatives.implementation_text: Project partners; Krakow side Department of Municipal Economy and Climate; international partners include Amsterdam, Bilbao, Bratislava, Budapest, Copenhagen, Matosinhos and Riga.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated Electricity reduction 48 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: EU Horizon 2020; Krakow-side budget PLN 1,259,765.

initiatives.initiative_name: COMANAGE project.
initiatives.general_description: Toolkit, methodology, operational framework and support services for creating and managing energy communities and citizen energy initiatives, including pilot hubs, e-learning and stakeholder mobilisation.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop community energy models, national recommendations for energy-company investment and educational campaigns for energy savings.
initiatives.implementation_text: Krakow Metropolis Association; ready-to-implement solutions involving project consortium and SMK municipalities.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Estimated Electricity reduction 269 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated total project budget PLN 7,300,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Development of distributed renewable energy generation.
initiatives.general_description: Distributed rooftop PV, heat pumps, RES on industrial buildings and brownfields, planning changes, documentation support for historic buildings, and prosumer subsidies/advice.
initiatives.objective_text: Support thermal modernisation and RES programmes and develop RES-based solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; city-wide action involving municipal companies, private companies and residents.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: 2030 generation: 345,564 MWh/year rooftop PV and 129,865 MWh/year industrial-site RES; 103,270 MWh/year from heat pumps; reductions 46,553 tCO2e Buildings/heating and 330,004 tCO2e Electricity.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 5,186,553,899.

initiatives.initiative_name: Creation of new photovoltaic farms to power the city.
initiatives.general_description: Increase RES electricity generation through new PV farms by energy companies and enterprises, using post-industrial areas and neighbouring municipalities where Krakow land availability is limited.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop RES-based solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; Krakow and neighbouring metropolitan municipalities; municipal companies, private companies and energy companies.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: 2030 PV farm generation 54,978 MWh/year; estimated Electricity reduction 36,597 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated cost PLN 290,400,000.

initiatives.initiative_name: Development of energy communities and energy awareness.
initiatives.general_description: Development of prosumer PV installations from 50 kW by 2030, local electricity generation and consumption, 23 MW/year PV growth from 2025 to 2030, virtual prosumer legal changes and resident education.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop community energy models, continue citizen energy advice and run energy-saving education campaigns.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity; residents, energy companies, housing associations, property managers, energy communities, banks and investors.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Renewable energy in 2030: 80,500 MWh; estimated Electricity reduction 53,500 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 480,000,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: 2024-2030; PV growth intensity 23 MW/year in 2025-2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Green energy purchase.
initiatives.general_description: Purchase of green electricity through the city group purchasing formula from 2025 to 2030 with planned volume of 100 GWh/year; previous 2021 agreement covered 424,000 MWh for 3,258 consumption points and reduced emissions by 325,000 tonnes CO2.
initiatives.objective_text: Purchasing green energy.
initiatives.implementation_text: Municipality of Krakow; city-wide action involving municipal companies and energy companies.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Planned green electricity purchase volume 100 GWh/year from 2025 to 2030; no future GHG reduction, receipts/costs or funding values in extracted source segment.
initiatives.delivery_text: Action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.funding_text: No funding or cost detail is present in the extracted source segment.
initiatives.timeline_text: 2024-2030; purchasing volume specified for 2025-2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Participation in the SmartEPC project
initiatives.general_description: Krakow participates as a pilot city in the Horizon 2020 SmartEPC project, replacing street lighting with energy-efficient lighting standards and testing Smart City uses of street lighting infrastructure, including LED lanterns for vehicle charging.
initiatives.objective_text: Reduce electricity consumption through technological upgrades.
initiatives.implementation_text: Innovation and technology action using street lighting infrastructure; impact sector in source is Electricity; system lever is Technology/Infrastructure.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Energy-efficient street lighting upgrades and pilot use of LED lanterns for vehicle charging within city administrative boundaries.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible unit: Krakow City Roads Board. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents and businesses.
initiatives.funding_text: Co-funded by the Horizon 2020 programme through the SmartEPC project; no local cost value stated in this segment.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2022-2024; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Project for fast, collision-free rail transport in Krakow (Premetro)
initiatives.general_description: Implementation of one Krakow pre-metro variant from the feasibility study for fast, collision-free rail transport. Seven route variants are under analysis from Jasnogorska Street in Bronowice to Mogila housing estate in Nowa Huta or Kocmyrzowska Street in Wzgorza Krzeslawickie.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand public transport infrastructure, expand the public transport fleet toward zero-emission, and develop the public transport system.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure and governance/policy levers. The action is in design phase.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: About 25 km of pre-metro route and about 20 interchange stops; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 6230 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Municipality of Krakow. Scope: city-wide action to increase transport accessibility. Stakeholders: residents and businesses.
initiatives.funding_text: Preliminary investment costs vary by variant; one likely variant is approximately PLN 4753050000, about EUR 1056233000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Construction of the SKA Krakow Pradnik Czerwony railway stop with Park & Ride and integrated transfer nodes
initiatives.general_description: Construction of a railway stop and P&R car park plus an integrated transfer node, bus terminal, and P&R Bronowice car park outside the city centre, aligned with ZIT and sustainable mobility objectives.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop public transport infrastructure and sustainable mobility by creating interchanges and P&R car parks around train and tram stations and stops.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Railway stop, P&R car parks, interchange, bus terminal, and integrated transfer node; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 2687 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Krakow Metropolis Association and Municipality of Krakow. Scope: less connected areas away from the city centre. Stakeholders: neighbouring municipality residents, city residents, and transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Funding obtained from the European Fund for Malopolska 2021-2027; estimated investment costs PLN 110000000, about EUR 24444000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Construction of cycle routes along Al. Pokoju, Walerego Slawka, Brozka, Nawojki, and Jancarza streets
initiatives.general_description: Construction of cycle paths along Al. Pokoju, Walery Slawek Street, the north side of Brozka Street, and cycle tracks along Nawojki and Jancarza Streets, in line with the Sustainable Mobility Plan for the Krakow Metropolis.
initiatives.objective_text: Create coherent pedestrian and cycling infrastructure, increase active mobility, improve sustainable mobility availability, and reduce pollutant emissions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: New cycle paths and tracks along the named corridors; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 1393 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Krakow Metropolis Association and Municipality of Krakow. Scope: named traffic routes with effects scaled to the city and metropolitan area. Stakeholders: neighbouring municipality residents, city residents, transport companies, and cycling associations.
initiatives.funding_text: Funding obtained from the European Fund for Malopolska 2021-2027; estimated investment costs about PLN 15000000, about EUR 3333000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Construction of KST tram line from Krowodrza Gorka to Azory district
initiatives.general_description: Construction of 2.5 km of KST tram track from Krowodrza Gorka terminus to Azory bus terminus with associated tram, road, pedestrian, cycling, P&R, and Bike&Ride infrastructure.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand public transport infrastructure, improve the public transport system, and encourage alternatives to private-car travel.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: 2.5 km of tram track; roofed Azory loop with terminal building; four bus stops; reconstructed streets and intersections; pavements and cycle paths; noise barriers; pedestrian/bicycle bridge; Area Traffic Control System; adapted footbridge with lifts; three-level P&R for 200 cars; covered Bike&Ride for 50 bicycles; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 4213 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Krakow Metropolis Association and Municipality of Krakow. Scope: named project corridor with city and metropolitan effects. Stakeholders: neighbouring municipality residents, city residents, and transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Funding attracted from the European Infrastructure, Climate and Environment Fund 2021-2027; estimated investment costs PLN 249997500, about EUR 55555000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Development of the tramway fleet and intelligent transport systems in Krakow
initiatives.general_description: Purchase of 30 new low-floor tram cars and development of ITS, including dynamic passenger information, vehicle auto-computers, VMS, detectors, transport network expansion, access control, number plate recognition, and parking information signs.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand the public transport fleet toward zero-emission, expand public transport infrastructure, improve public transport functioning, and encourage public transport and alternative modes.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: 30 low-floor trams: 10 two-way 32-34 m cars, 10 one-way 32-34 m cars, and 10 one-way 42-45 m cars, plus ITS equipment and systems; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 2372 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Krakow Metropolis Association, Municipality of Krakow, and Municipal Public Transport Company S.A. Scope: city-wide impact. Stakeholders: neighbouring municipality residents, city residents, and transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Funding attracted from the European Infrastructure, Climate and Environment Fund 2021-2027; estimated investment costs PLN 521967488, about EUR 115992000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: ZIT - Reconstruction of tram tracks, turnouts, and associated infrastructure at Straszewskiego, Karmelicka, and Starowislna streets
initiatives.general_description: Reconstruction of tram tracks in Straszewskiego and Karmelicka Streets, related turnout junctions, overhead line, lighting, drainage, road system, and the track/road section from Dietla Street to Powstancow Slaskich Bridge, including pavements and cycle paths.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand public transport infrastructure, improve the public transport system, and support alternatives to private-car travel.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Reconstructed tram tracks, turnouts, overhead catenary network, drainage, lighting, road system, pavements, and cycle paths; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 2807 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Krakow Metropolis Association and Municipality of Krakow. Scope: city-wide impact. Stakeholders: neighbouring municipality residents, city residents, and transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Source states funding from the European Infrastructure, Climate and Environment Fund but the cost line is truncated in this segment.
initiatives.timeline_text: Action only in design phase; currently no timetable or milestones stated.

initiatives.initiative_name: Creation of new charging stations for electric buses
initiatives.general_description: Creation of two pantograph charging stations for electric buses on Luzycka Street, two pantograph stations on Stojalowskiego Street, and one pantograph station on Rydgiera Street.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand the public transport fleet toward zero-emission, expand public transport infrastructure, and support energy harvesting, storage, and cost-effective distribution programmes.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with Technology/Infrastructure lever.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Five electric-bus pantograph charging stations; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 2074 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Municipal Public Transport Company in Krakow. Scope: local transport system. Stakeholders: transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 6500000, about EUR 1444000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date 2024; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Tram Energy Storage in District XII and District XI of Krakow
initiatives.general_description: Storage of energy returned to the grid through tram recuperation and support for traction substations by returning stored energy to the grid to reduce voltage drops.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand public transport infrastructure and support energy generation, storage, and economical energy distribution.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructure measure with Technology/Infrastructure lever.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Tram energy storage installations in District XII and District XI; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 1258 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Krakow City Roads Board. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: transport companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated investment costs PLN 14000000, about EUR 3111000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2024-2025; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of new tram lines with associated infrastructure
initiatives.general_description: Modernisation of tram tracks and associated infrastructure and creation of new tram lines: Cichy Kacik - Azory, Osiedle Krowodrza Gorka - Azory, part of the KST line Meissnera Street - Mistrzejowice, and Krowodrza Gorka - Gorka Narodowa Settlement.
initiatives.objective_text: Expand the public transport fleet toward zero-emission, expand public transport infrastructure, and develop the public transport system.
initiatives.implementation_text: Technical and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure and governance/policy levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: New and modernised tram lines with associated infrastructure; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 11107 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities: Municipal Investment Board, Department of City Treasury, and Krakow City Roads Board. Scope: city administrative boundaries. Stakeholders: residents and construction and industrial companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Actions financed by different actors on different time scales; costs are hard to estimate; approximately PLN 615000000 by 2030, about EUR 136666000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Addresses the emissions gap; completion dates depend on the specific infrastructure section, with cost estimate stated through 2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Projects and activities for cycling infrastructure and the Cycling Policy of the City of Krakow
initiatives.general_description: A broad set of pedestrian and cycling transport activities, including implementation of the city Cycling Policy and projects such as Bike to School - Stars promoting cycling to school among pupils, parents, and teachers.
initiatives.objective_text: Extend pedestrian and cycle infrastructure, encourage alternatives to private-car travel, and popularise alternative means of transport.
initiatives.implementation_text: Organisational and infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Cycling infrastructure and promotion activities under the city Cycling Policy; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 2446 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entities vary by project: Krakow City Council Department of Municipal Economy and Climate, Krakow City Roads Board, and Public Transport Board. Scope: city administrative boundaries. Stakeholders: residents.
initiatives.funding_text: Activities funded by different actors on different time scales; costs hard to determine because development and maintenance costs are often not separated; estimated cost PLN 23000000, about EUR 5111000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timing depends on the specific project; broader description to be provided in future document iterations; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: SUM project - Smooth Shared Urban Mobility
initiatives.general_description: Participation in the SUM project to create sustainable and efficient urban transport solutions, reduce transport emissions and congestion, and pilot a new shared mobility system in selected Krakow areas. The project targets 15 European cities by 2026 and 30 cities by 2030.
initiatives.objective_text: Popularise car-pooling and alternative modes of transport through regulation and popularise alternative means such as scooters.
initiatives.implementation_text: Organisational action with governance/policy and education/skills levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Pilot of a new shared mobility system in selected city areas; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 29 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Public Transport Board. Scope: action based on ready-to-implement solutions. Stakeholders: project partner cities.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated total costs PLN 1592697, about EUR 353000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2023-2026; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Clean Transport Zone
initiatives.general_description: A Krakow Clean Transport Zone roughly matching the city boundaries, excluding motorways through the city, where the most polluting old cars, including vehicles over 30 years old, will not be allowed to drive.
initiatives.objective_text: Create a Clean Transport Zone and change use of public spaces, including fewer parking spaces and pedestrian streets.
initiatives.implementation_text: Organisational action with governance/policy lever.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: City-wide Clean Transport Zone; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 3677 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Public Transport Board. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents and car companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 685000, about EUR 152000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2023-2025; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Programme to support modern forms of local transport and organisation of the transport system
initiatives.general_description: Programme supporting alternative modes and dedicated infrastructure so residents choose cycling, public transport, car-pooling, shared modes, and remote work because they are economically viable, time-efficient, and comfortable.
initiatives.objective_text: Extend pedestrian and cycling infrastructure, popularise car-pooling and alternative modes, develop public transport, change public-space use, promote scooters and bicycles, and reduce commuting through hybrid and remote working.
initiatives.implementation_text: Financial and organisational action using technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, education/skills, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: New and modernised cycling and pedestrian infrastructure; safe crossings; car-pooling incentives and zones; public transport frequency and smart solutions; bus-priority road changes; reduced parking and pedestrian zones; scooter and bicycle rental points; remote-work support and digital infrastructure; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 28090 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents, motor businesses, cyclists, NGOs, and businesses.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 90000000, about EUR 20000000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2024-2030; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Development of sustainable logistics
initiatives.general_description: Municipal programme to improve sustainable logistics and loading of freight transport through logistics centres, consolidation points, intelligent logistics systems, cooperation between companies, clean transport investments, low-emission zones, entry restrictions for empty vehicles, optimised delivery timing, education, and regulatory support.
initiatives.objective_text: Regulate freight transport requirements and reduce transport emissions from urban freight and logistics.
initiatives.implementation_text: Organisational action with governance/policy lever.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Logistics centres and freight consolidation points; digital platforms for loads and spare vehicle capacity; route optimisation and GPS fleet management; logistics co-operatives and partnerships; incentives for electric and hybrid fleets; rail transport promotion; low-emission zones and empty-vehicle restrictions; night deliveries and delivery time windows; training and campaigns; mandatory reporting of vehicle load levels; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 10000 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents, transport companies, logistics hubs, retail businesses, shopkeepers, and wholesalers.
initiatives.funding_text: Costs are currently very hard to estimate because of the innovative nature of the measure and will be completed in future updates.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2024-2030; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Long-term programme to popularise and develop electric mobility infrastructure (new charging stations)
initiatives.general_description: Long-term programme to increase the share of public and private electric cars and expand charging infrastructure through public and private charging stations, incentives, education, smart charging, research, partnerships, monitoring, and evaluation.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop a network of electric car chargers, expand the public transport fleet toward zero-emission, support energy storage and cost-effective distribution, and popularise car-pooling and alternative modes.
initiatives.implementation_text: Finance and technology action using technology/infrastructure and governance/policy levers.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: At least 150 new public charging stations in the first five years, location planning, PPP cooperation, private charging requirements and grants, EV purchase incentives, parking discounts and dedicated spaces, preferential loans, education and test drives, smart charging systems, R&D, business and international partnerships, monitoring systems, and regular reports; estimated transport-sector GHG reduction of 56180 tCO2e.
initiatives.delivery_text: Responsible entity: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. Scope: administrative boundaries of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents and car companies.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs PLN 180000000, about EUR 40000000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe 2024-2030; action addresses the emissions gap.

initiatives.initiative_name: Construction of a recycling system for biodegradable waste and in the process composting and fermentation - electricity and biogas production.
initiatives.general_description: Multi-phase technical and infrastructural project to build a plastics recycling plant, municipal waste recovery facility, bulky waste recovery plant, selective municipal waste collection point, treated-waste and recycled-product storage, and rooftop photovoltaic generation for facility operations.
initiatives.objective_text: Impact pathways identify waste management and circular economy plus electricity impacts through systems for producing energy from waste sources, recycling and waste treatment infrastructure, and RES-based solutions.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Municipal Cleaning Company. Stakeholders include residents and businesses. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Plastics recycling plant; municipal waste recovery facility; bulky waste recovery plant; selective municipal waste collection point; municipal waste storage facility for treated waste, waste generated, and recycling-process products; rooftop photovoltaic installation.
initiatives.delivery_text: Technical and infrastructural action delivered by the Municipal Cleaning Company for city waste management users, residents, and businesses.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs: PLN 70,000,000, approximately EUR 15,555,000. Renewable energy generation value to be defined in later design proceedings and future iterations.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2024-2027.

initiatives.initiative_name: MINEV project.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and innovative Waste MINimisation in Large EVents project under the INTERREG EUROPE Programme, implemented by Krakow municipal staff to prevent or minimise waste generation during events.
initiatives.objective_text: The main objective is to explore city options and implement measures that prevent or minimise waste generation when organising events, making events more sustainable and environmentally friendly. Good practices are to be identified for closed, open, sports, business, cultural, scientific, religious, and other event types.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Municipality of Krakow - Department of Municipal Economy and Climate. City-wide action involving numerous stakeholders linked to events and residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Identification of good practices for waste minimisation across event types and implementation of measures to prevent or reduce event waste.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and innovative action with social innovation, education, and skills levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated total costs: PLN 754,440, approximately EUR 167,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2023-2027.

initiatives.initiative_name: Smart Circuit project.
initiatives.general_description: International innovation and organisational circular-economy project implemented by a consortium of 12 companies and institutions from nine European countries, strengthening digital innovation hubs and applying new technologies for circular economy implementation.
initiatives.objective_text: The project supports transformation of manufacturing industry toward smarter growth and green technologies in textiles, construction, ICT/electronics, and cross-sectoral areas, including a pilot CE implementation in an industrial plant.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Krakow Technology Park. Scale and stakeholders: manufacturing companies from the Malopolska region. Strategic partner: Malopolska Voivodeship; technology partner: Ergo Design.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: CE Academy training platform; publication with 122 examples of successful circular economy mechanisms including 10 from Malopolska; interviews and strategic meetings with administrations; pilot implementation of circular economy in an industrial plant.
initiatives.delivery_text: Education and skills lever delivered through a supra-regional knowledge-sharing platform, good-practice publication, business relationship building, strategic meetings, and pilot implementation.
initiatives.funding_text: Total financial costs: EUR 240,000, approximately PLN 1,050,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date: 2023-2026.

initiatives.initiative_name: Development of Krakow's Circular Economy.
initiatives.general_description: Management and innovation measure to develop a circular economy in Krakow through automation of sorting processes at two sorting plants, composting plant modernisation, adaptation of the dismantling plant for increased bulky waste, and preparation of a Circular Economy Action Plan for Krakow until 2030.
initiatives.objective_text: Impact pathways cite continuation of the Circular Strategy for Krakow, reusable materials systems, recycling and waste-treatment infrastructure, and public information on recycling benefits and methods.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. City-wide action involving municipal companies, businesses, developers, residents, construction companies, and material manufacturers. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Sorting automation at both operating sorting plants; composting plant modernisation; Dismantling Plant adaptation for bulky waste; Stage I analysis and SWOT diagnosis of circular economy in Krakow; Stage II development and adoption of a Circular Economy Action Plan.
initiatives.delivery_text: Technology/infrastructure plus education and skills action, co-financed under the National Centre for Research and Development GOSPOSTRATEG 2 programme for plan preparation.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated cost of action: PLN 30,000,000, approximately EUR 6,666,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2024-2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Creation of new green spaces.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical action to establish new public green areas such as city parks, river parks, city meadows, forest parks, ecological parks, and fortress green areas, following Krakow green-area development directions for 2019-2030.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop green infrastructure and urban parks, increase forest cover and urban greenery, and consult residents on green-space development. The measure also aims to improve carbon dioxide absorption through semi-natural management, flower meadows, biocenotic zones, and high biologically active surface ratios.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Krakow Municipal Greenery Board. City-wide action in different parts of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: XXL Park at Witkowicki Forest and the Pradnik Valley, park on the Ulga Canal, continuation of Podgorze Green Ring, further river parks under Wisla Laczy, White Sea Park, and green-area management changes that improve sequestration.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure, governance and policy, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: No cost or funding line is present in the provided source segment for I-1.
initiatives.timeline_text: Timing depends on the specific project; the cited green-area directions cover 2019-2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Increasing the area of urban forests.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical action implementing the District Programme for Increasing the Forest Cover of the City of Krakow 2018-2040, including property purchase for new forests, afforestation of land, and forest planting campaigns with residents.
initiatives.objective_text: Increase forest cover and urban green space, develop green infrastructure and urban parks, and consult residents on green-space development.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Krakow Municipal Greenery Board. City-wide action in different parts of Krakow. Stakeholders: residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Forests ultimately to constitute at least 8% of the municipality area, supported by land purchases, afforestation, and resident forest-planting campaigns.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure, governance and policy, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs of action: PLN 37,000,000, approximately EUR 8,222,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: District programme period: 2018-2040. Task timing depends on the specific project.

initiatives.initiative_name: Maintain a high ratio of biologically active area in the city.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical land-use action to maintain biologically active area through spatial planning provisions, the planned General Plan of Krakow, land acquisition for green areas, nature protection for high-value areas including wetlands, and unsealing impermeable surfaces in road lanes, squares, and car parks.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop green infrastructure and urban parks and increase forest cover and urban green space within the city.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible units: Municipality of Krakow Department of Spatial Planning, Department of City Treasury, Department of Environmental Management, Krakow City Roads Board, and Krakow Municipal Greenery Board. City-wide action involving residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Local spatial development provisions, General Plan provisions, municipal land acquisition for green areas, protection of high-value natural areas including wetlands, replacement of hardened surfaces with biologically active areas, new green belts, lawns, and tree windows.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure and governance/policy levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs: PLN 325,000,000, approximately EUR 72,222,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timing depends on the specific project.

initiatives.initiative_name: Introduce smaller forms of green infrastructure in heavily build-up parts of the city.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical action introducing green roofs, green walls, climbing plants and vertical gardens, pocket parks, community gardens, flower meadows, trees in city squares and road lanes, and Urban Groves in dense built-up areas.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop green infrastructure and urban parks, increase forest cover and urban greenery, and consult residents on green-space development.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible units: Krakow Municipal Greenery Board, Krakow City Roads Board, Climate-Energy-Water Management, and other municipal organisational units and municipal companies running investments or managing buildings. City-wide action involving residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Green roofs and walls, pocket parks, community gardens, flower meadows, trees in squares and road lanes, Urban Groves, and possible incentives for individuals and external bodies to establish green roofs and walls.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure, governance and policy, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs of action: PLN 28,000,000, approximately EUR 6,222,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timing depends on the specific project.

initiatives.initiative_name: Planting of trees, shrubs and protection of existing trees.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical action covering tree and shrub planting on Municipality of Krakow land, higher natural compensation through replacement planting requirements, and implementation of detailed municipal tree-protection principles for investments.
initiatives.objective_text: Develop green infrastructure and urban parks, increase forest cover and urban greenery, and consult residents on green-space development.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible units: Department of Environmental Management, Municipal Conservator of Monuments, and entities managing real estate for the Municipality of Krakow, including municipal organisational units and companies. City-wide action involving residents. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Tree and shrub planting, replacement planting requirements for greenery removal decisions, and implementation of Ordinance No. 591/2024 on tree protection and minimum replacement plantings.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure, governance and policy, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated costs of action: PLN 64,000,000, approximately EUR 14,222,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timing depends on the specific project. Ordinance cited: 26 February 2024.

initiatives.initiative_name: The CoFarm4Cities project.
initiatives.general_description: Innovative and social international project with nine actors developing environmentally friendly responses to urban sprawl by identifying and sustainably using peri-urban agricultural, mixed, or abandoned areas and developing a stakeholder engagement model to transform them into urban farms.
initiatives.objective_text: Objectives include development and promotion of urban agriculture, biodiversity protection, increased use of undeveloped urban land, nature-based solutions, sustainable urban development, and climate change adaptation.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Krakow Municipal Greenery Board. Action develops ready-to-implement solutions with partner cities, residents, NGOs, schools and kindergartens, universities, and other cities that may replicate the solution. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Stakeholder engagement model, urban-farm transformation solutions for peri-urban agricultural/mixed/abandoned land, and replicable nature-based urban agriculture approaches.
initiatives.delivery_text: Innovative and social action using democracy/social participation, education and skills, and social innovation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated total costs: PLN 1,300,935, approximately EUR 289,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2023-2026.

initiatives.initiative_name: Life Pact Project - The human factor: Adapting the City for Tomorrow.
initiatives.general_description: Socio-infrastructural LIFE PACT project to develop and test an integrated approach to urban climate adaptation through nature-based solutions, implemented by partners from Belgium, Spain, and Poland, with Leuven as pilot city and coordinator.
initiatives.objective_text: The infrastructure component creates two rain gardens and three green public spaces to reduce the urban heat island effect, while also consulting residents and educating on environmental responsibility and urban greenery.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Climate - Energy - Water Management. Local activities in Krakow with Madrid, Leuven, and residents as stakeholders. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Two rain gardens and three green public spaces, plus engagement and education activities connected to nature-based adaptation.
initiatives.delivery_text: Socio-infrastructural action with technology/infrastructure, education and skills, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated total costs: approximately PLN 3,709,123, approximately EUR 824,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2022-2025.

initiatives.initiative_name: Greene 4.0 project.
initiatives.general_description: Innovation and organisational project by a consortium of nine companies and institutions from seven European countries to support small and medium-sized manufacturing companies in green and digital innovation, new supply chains, green production practices, and reduced environmental impact.
initiatives.objective_text: Support SMEs in implementing green and digital innovations, creating new supply chains, saving energy and natural resources, and replacing heavy carbon-intensive industry with activities based on new technologies.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Krakow Technology Park. Scale and stakeholders: manufacturing companies from the Malopolska region.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Manufacturing-company survey, survey report, workshops, knowledge exchange platform, platform connecting manufacturers with start-ups and solution providers, tools supporting green transformation, support for smart and green innovation, start-up acceleration, market validation support, and innovation ecosystem connections.
initiatives.delivery_text: Innovation and organisational action delivered through governance/policy instruments and regional innovation ecosystem services.
initiatives.funding_text: Total funding: approximately EUR 270,000, approximately PLN 1,210,000.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned completion date: 2023-2026.

initiatives.initiative_name: Usage of CCS, CCU technology and carbon capture
initiatives.general_description: Technical action planning a CCS plant and knowledge transfer for CCS/CCU implementation linked to the Thermal Waste Conversion Plant in Krakow, including cooperation with Norwegian companies Vinco Innovation and CO2 Management.
initiatives.objective_text: Displace carbon-intensive emission and pollution sources and replace heavy carbon-intensive industry with activities based on new technologies. The action targets carbon capture and sequestration or utilisation knowledge and future implementation.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. City-wide action involving municipal companies, enterprises, technical universities, scientific institutes, and NGOs. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Strategic partnership with Norwegian companies; business report on economic, organisational, legal, and environmental issues for CCS at an eco-combustion plant; technical report on CCSU capture, transboundary transport, geological sequestration, and storage sites; possible comprehensive operation from 2030.
initiatives.delivery_text: Technical action with technology/infrastructure and governance/policy levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated cost is difficult to determine due to limited dissemination of CCS technology and is to be completed in future iterations.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2024-2030; report indicates comprehensive operation could start as early as 2030.

initiatives.initiative_name: Reclamation of post-industrial areas in Nowa Huta district.
initiatives.general_description: Organisational and technical action to reclaim post-industrial areas in Nowa Huta and open the space for residents, including land acquisition, recultivation, social reintegration measures, support for new technology industries, resident consultation, and green-space development.
initiatives.objective_text: Displace carbon-intensive emission and pollution sources, replace heavy carbon-intensive industry with activities based on new technologies, and consult residents on green-space development.
initiatives.implementation_text: Responsible unit: Municipality of Krakow as monitoring entity. City-wide action involving municipal companies, enterprises, technical universities, scientific institutes, and NGOs. The action addresses the emissions gap.
initiatives.planned_outputs_text: Acquisition of 300 hectares of industrial land; recultivation; technology parks and business incubators; R&D centres with universities and institutes; incentives such as subsidies, tax breaks, and special economic zones for low-carbon technology firms; resident workshops, surveys, working groups, education programmes; new parks, gardens, squares, cycle routes, walking paths, green roofs and walls, protected areas, and nature reserves.
initiatives.delivery_text: Organisational and technical action with technology/infrastructure, governance/policy, and democracy/social participation levers.
initiatives.funding_text: Estimated cost is currently difficult to determine due to dynamic changes among industrial enterprises in the Nowa Huta area and will be completed in future updates.
initiatives.timeline_text: Planned timeframe: 2024-2030.
